inputs.original_text: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed a bill on Thursday requiring new registered voters to prove they are United States citizens to cast a ballot in state elections. The press release said Senate Bill 175 applies only to state elections and affects only new registrants.
inputs.modified_text: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday. It requires new registered voters to prove they are United States citizens to vote in state elections. The bill applies only to state elections and affects only new registrants.
